title: Visiting Jelly Roll Morton in New York
summary: Before the Harris show, someone took her to Morton's office, where he roughly corrected her playing of 'Pearls'. She was not writing then.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: O.K., now, we left you in New York and that's Jelly Roll Morton? when you met Fats Waller. Was that when you met John Williams?
I met John Williams while I was with the Buzzy Harris show.
No, I said Jelly Roll Morton.

Before I joined the Buzzin' Harris show somebody brought me to New York for a visit, some musical person. I was playing so much of Jelly Roll Morton until somebody took me to his office... I was not with the band or anything.
And that was when you played the Pearls' for him?
I see, and you were told that was not the way to play it?
Did you play some of your own things for him then too?

No, I was only interested in him. I don't think I was writing too much then. I was just playing things that I heard or people were teaching me new tunes or things like that. I didn't start to write until I was with Andy Kirk.
